context:
Add new entries to the existing ignore_rules list in pyproject.toml under
[tool.benchbox.duplicates]. Follow the established pattern: group by
path_contains scope, list specific function_names.

Strategy per group type:
1. Protocol/ABC stubs (G8,G9,G11,G22): Ignore by function name within
   benchbox/core/dataframe/ and benchbox/platforms/dataframe/ paths
2. Platform adapter wrappers (G3,G10,G14): Ignore by function name within
   benchbox/platforms/ paths
3. Benchmark facade methods (G2,G5): Ignore by function name (global or
   path-scoped to core/*/benchmark.py and top-level modules)
4. TPC-DS/TPC-DI domain (G1,G6,G7,G26,G28): Ignore by function name
   within specific tpcds/tpcdi paths
5. Multi-backend dispatch (G18,G20): Ignore within unified_frame.py and
   expression_family.py
6. Benchmark config methods (G16): Ignore get_schema/get_csv_loading_config
   across benchmark modules

After adding rules, run `make duplicate-check-verbose` to verify reduction,
then lower the threshold proportionally.
description:
The `make duplicate-check-verbose` report identifies 396 duplicate function groups
totaling 12,666 duplicated lines. Analysis of the top 30 groups reveals that 17 are
intentional boilerplate - interface-conforming stubs, protocol/ABC declarations,
platform adapter wrappers, and TPC-DS spec-mandated query patterns.

These groups should be suppressed via ignore_rules in pyproject.toml
[tool.benchbox.duplicates] to reduce noise and focus the duplicate checker on
genuine consolidation opportunities.

Groups to ignore (by report rank):
- G1  (344 lines): _fact_map/_role_aliases/_income_band_aliases in tpcds_obt/etl/transformer.py
- G2  (180 lines): get_queries_by_category/get_query_info facade delegation methods across benchmark.py files
- G3  (175 lines): _detect_format/col/get_dataframe_operations in dataframe platform adapters
- G5  (140 lines): execute_rule/get_operation/get_table_row_count domain-specific manager protocols
- G6  (132 lines): _load_base_queries/_load_etl_queries TPC-DI query dict builders
- G7  (120 lines): get_queries_by_category/complexity/frequency in tpcdi/query_*.py
- G8  (117 lines): cast_date/cast_string/col abstract stubs in dataframe context/protocols
- G9  (116 lines): filter/limit/scalar_to_df abstract method declarations
- G10 (100 lines): col/from_pandas/lit platform-specific thin wrappers
- G11  (99 lines): can_provide/create_schema/date_add abstract method stubs across ABCs
- G14  (91 lines): apply_platform_optimizations cloud platform stubs
- G16  (90 lines): get_schema/get_csv_loading_config benchmark interface conformance
- G18  (88 lines): first/floor/last multi-backend dispatch in unified_frame.py
- G20  (87 lines): max_/mean/std multi-backend dispatch in expression_family.py
- G22  (80 lines): _do_delete/delete_rows/generate_tuning_clauses Protocol+ABC stubs
- G26  (75 lines): q33/q60 expression_impl TPC-DS spec-mandated query family
- G28  (70 lines): q33/q60 pandas_impl TPC-DS spec-mandated query family

After adding these rules, the threshold in pyproject.toml should be lowered to
match the new effective duplicate count, preventing regressions.
